title: feat(menu-item): migrate swc-menu-item to Spectrum 2 (#6949)
evidence:
Add the gen2 `<swc-menu>`, the Spectrum 2 successor to `<sp-menu>`.

- **API**: `for` / `triggerElement` reference an externally-authored trigger (the menu renders none of its own), plus `placement` (12 values, default `bottom-start`), `should-flip` (default `true`), the reflected `open`, and `size`
